_comment: Greenhouse board tokens are CONFIGURATION, not code. The token is the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> and in the API path /v1/boards/<token>/jobs. Going from one company to fifty is an edit to this file and nothing else -- no code change, no test change. Nothing here is derived from any user's profile; this source is shared exactly like the LinkedIn pool.
_limits_comment: Embedding batch packing, and ONLY that. The model and its dimensions are deliberately NOT here: this file ships inside the ingestion image and the API cannot read it, so a model named here could differ from the one retrieval uses, and that failure is silent. They live in Greenhouse:Embedding (GreenhouseEmbeddingOptions), which both halves bind.
_budget_comment: The token budget is what a batch is FILLED to; max_batch_items caps how many texts go in one request regardless of size. voyage-4's real ceiling is 320K tokens -- over three times this -- so split-and-retry should never fire in production. It is implemented and tested anyway, because the 120K-limit families (voyage-4-large, voyage-3-large, voyage-code-3) are one config edit away, and then this number is the only thing between a run and a hard 400.
